build_cmd: export PATH=$HOME/.local/bin:$PATH && qmk compile -kb crkbd/rev1 -km default && mkdir -p .build/membrowse_ld && avr-gcc -mmcu=atmega32u4 -Wl,--verbose -x c /dev/null -o /dev/null 2>&1 | sed -n '/^======/,/^======/p' | grep -v '^======' > .build/membrowse_ld/avr5.ld
